ticket.summary: Customers can apply a discount code at checkout

approval.note: User approved the 7-test plan and the two stubs.

notes: The ticket's parent is an epic (BILL-100); only this story was worked on.
Shipping is out of scope per the ticket description; no requirement was taken from it.

fixtures: tests/conftest.py: cart_of(*prices) builds a Cart with one line per price
conventions.assertion_style: plain assert; pytest.raises(..., match=...) for errors

exemplars.why_chosen: Tests Cart totals with the cart_of fixture; same module as apply_code

requirements.text: Applying a valid percentage code to a cart whose subtotal is at least the code's minimum spend reduces the total by that percentage.
requirements.source_excerpt: when a valid percentage code is applied, then the total is reduced by that percentage

requirements.text: The discounted total is rounded to the nearest cent.
requirements.notes: Only a case that is not a half cent is tested; the half-cent rule is open question Q-1.

requirements.text: Codes are matched case-insensitively, ignoring surrounding spaces.
requirements.source_excerpt: Codes are case-insensitive and ignore surrounding spaces.

requirements.text: An expired code is rejected with "This code has expired" and the total is unchanged.
requirements.source_excerpt: An expired code is rejected with the message "This code has expired" and the total is unchanged.

requirements.text: A cart holds at most one code; applying a second code replaces the first.
requirements.source_excerpt: Only one code can be applied per cart; applying a second code replaces the first.

requirements.text: Below the minimum spend the code is rejected with "Spend $X more to use this code", X being the shortfall.
requirements.source_excerpt: the code is rejected with "Spend $X more to use this code", where X is the shortfall

requirements.text: The discount appears as a separate line on the order confirmation email.
requirements.source_excerpt: The discount appears as a separate line on the order confirmation email.
requirements.notes: The repository has no email rendering or email tests.

requirements.text: Discounts do not apply to gift cards.
requirements.source_excerpt: Discounts don't apply to gift cards.

open_questions.question: AC-1 says 'rounded to the nearest cent' but not how a half cent rounds (0.125 to 0.12 or 0.13). Half-up or half-even?
How is a gift card identified in a cart? Cart lines only have sku, unit_price and quantity, so REQ-8 cannot be tested until this is decided.

manual_checks.check: Place an order with SAVE10 and check the confirmation email shows the discount as its own line.
manual_checks.reason: No email rendering code or email test setup exists in this repository.
